files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- New look for APP
- Paryers times with calendar choice for dates
- Add support for Nextcloud 34
### Changed
- Use of nextcloud Vuejs instead of old templates
- Use of json instead of Markdown in the widget
